title: Monte Bank
betGuide: Pick a layout card and choose your stake
suitNotice: Only the suit matters — rank never decides a round
tutorial.layout: Back one of the four layout cards. Only the suit matters; rank is never used
tutorial.even: A suit showing once is an even bet. Two or more showing costs you before the gate is even turned
tutorial.gate: The next card off the deck settles it — a suit match pays 3:1
frontendHint.monteBankLoneSuit: only one of this suit is showing, so 3:1 makes it an even bet
frontendHint.monteBankAllDuplicated: every suit is showing at least twice, so no bet here is even
